text:
samir: FYI - Nebula AI POC asking for a Dedicated commit with burst carveout. Need deal desk approval for pricing tweak and limited waiver.

maya: quick q - what's their target concurrency and model footprint?

samir: they run long-context models (~8k tokens), mostly H100 inference. baseline: 12 reserved GPUs (8x H100 + 4x A100), want autoscale up to 20 for short spikes. POC term 3 months.

alesha: customer asks: make burst priced at 50% of reserved list for the POC window. that's a heavy concession. asking for an internal approval path.

maya: rough calc: list H100 = $12.00/GPU-hour, A100 = $6.50/GPU-hour. reserved blended = $10.2/hr. 50% burst -> $5.1/hr blended. margin hit is material. propose tiered burst: first 1200 burst GPU-hours at 70% list, remainder at 85%. also propose waive overage for first 1200 hours as POC carveout.

maya: autoscale snippet for eng: ```autoscale_policy: { "min_replicas":12, "max_replicas":20, "burst_window_minutes":10, "burst_type":"short" }```

nick: finance - need dollarized impact and ARR delta. paste exact numbers for reserved revenue, expected burst usage, and margin. I can sign off if margin >= 28% after concession.

samir: proposed commercial terms (for quote): 3-month commit, 12 GPUs reserved (8 H100 + 4 A100), baseline blended price $10.20/GPU-hr, commit discount -> effective $8.16/hr baseline. Burst = tiered: first 1200 GPU-hrs @70% list ($7.14/hr blended), subsequent burst @85% list ($8.67/hr). Waive overage for first 1200 burst hours. Need deal desk + finance approval.

emma: eng note: autoscale to 20 is supported but warm-up for KV cache will cause a 2-6s latency bump on scale-up. recommend fallback to a quantized variant during burst to keep p95 < target. also confirm VPC/private deployment for PII handling.

alesha: sending customer the above as a POC offer, flagged as conditional on deal desk sign-off and security questionnaire exception for burst handling.

dealbot: Deal Desk ticket created DD-20260321-874 by alesha. https://redwood.internal/deal/DD-20260321-874 (status: awaiting-finance) :spiral_notepad:

nick: ran the numbers - with the tiered burst + 1200-hr waiver margin ~31% over the 3-month term. if we waive all burst pricing margin drops to ~22% — not acceptable without exec sign-off.

maya: agree with nick. approve tiered + limited waiver for POC. we should include a hard cap on waived hours and a clause to convert burst to paid at next milestone.

samir: thanks - I'll update the SOW and include the autoscale/quantization note for eng, plus the security exception request. tagging legal for T&Cs.

dealbot: Deal Desk status: pending finance sign-off -> finance approved. Reaction :white_check_mark:
